title: Customers Delete removes the customer record
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Customers View, Create & Edit and Delete.
custom_steps:
1. Open a test customer with no open work orders or recent invoices.
  2. Delete the customer.
evidence: UI (role with Customers Delete): the Edit Customer modal shows a Delete button -> Confirmation dialog "Are you sure you want to delete this company?" [Cancel|Delete] -> confirming removes the customer and returns to /customers. Verified end-to-end on a seeded ZZAUTOTEST customer (created then deleted). screenshot cust-delete2.
